India insulating growth from global shocks, says Minister Vaishnaw

Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that India is insulating its economic growth from global shocks. He used the analogy of "friends becoming foes" to describe how India guards against geopolitical shocks. Vaishnaw made these remarks in the context of global economic uncertainties.
